prose: Yerasimos Stilianessis and Sophie Fletcher are a bio-dynamic duo with a huge amount of holistic health knowledge. Yerasimos is a transformational bodywork coach, and Sophie is a PHD student in Depth Psychology.
We talk about the necessity of touch in a world of social distancing, the mind control manipulation of big-pharma, and whether trauma can be healed through the body.
ext: We look deeper at medical colonialism, the spiritual perspective on addiction, and the alchemical perspective on alcohol.
